10310267.en: I... I've been having strange dreams lately... The me in those dreams feels different from who I am now, yet somehow still myself... That version of me understands so much more than I do now and is much more clever...
10310267.ch: 我……最近总是做一些奇怪的梦……梦里面的我，好像不是现在我的，但又好像就是我自己……可那个我比现在的我懂事得多，聪明得多……

10310268.en: After speaking, {name|B}'s gaze falls on your hand resting by the feet. She pauses for a moment, then reaches out and gently places her hand on the back of yours...
10310268.ch: {name|B}说完这话，她看着你放在脚边的手呆了一下，然后伸手过来按着你的手背……

10310269.en: I'm sorry... I just... they were holding hands even as they died, and I only wanted to know why... no... I-I should go back now...
10310269.ch: 对不起……我就是……他们临死都要牵着对方，我只是想知道为什么……不是……我、我该回去了……唉，这边的残魂灵力已经不够，接下来我要去云陌州继续查探陨幽谷，你……记得来找我呀。

10310270.en: {name|B} springs to her feet, hastily dusts off her clothes, and hurries away...
10310270.ch: {name|B}腾地站起，匆匆忙忙拍了拍身上尘土，然后急步走了……

10310271.en: {name|B} glances at you with a shy, hesitant expression. After what seems like careful deliberation, she takes a deep breath as if having made up her mind, then gently places her hand on the back of yours...
10310271.ch: {name|B}看了看你，脸上呈现扭捏的神态。她似乎考虑再三，然后作了什么决定似的大大的吸了口气，然后伸手搭在你的手背上……

10310274.en: As you leave, you seem to hear {name|B} let out a soft sigh...
10310274.ch: 你离开之际，仿佛听到{name|B}发出轻轻的一声叹息……

10310275.en: Mmm... I just feel such pity for them. In this life, it's so hard for wishes to come true, isn't it? Sigh. The energy of the soul fragments here is depleted. I need to head to Yun Mo to continue investigating the Fallen Valley. Don't forget... to come find me there.
10310275.ch: 嗯……我只是觉得他们好可怜，人生在世，许多事情都很难如愿吧？唉，这边的残魂灵力已经不够，接下来我要去云陌州继续查探陨幽谷，你……记得来找我呀。

10310278.en: I... I've been having strange dreams lately... The me in those dreams feels different from who I am now, yet somehow still myself... That version of me understands so much more than I do now...
10310278.ch: 我……最近总是做一些奇怪的梦……梦里面的我，好像不是现在我的，但又好像就是我自己……可那个我比现在的我懂事得多，聪明得多……

10310286.en: You arrive at {name|B}'s residence. The house known as the Origin Box has grown increasingly elegant and beautiful...
10310286.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，这所名为归元木匣的房子越发精致华美……

10310287.en: You stir the divination table, and the fine sand ripples like silk before instantly taking on a human shape.
10310287.ch: 你拨动沙盘，上面细砂起伏如缎，瞬间聚起人形。

10310288.en: The Handmaiden has grown melancholic and depressed, having noticed many things she was never meant to perceive.
10310288.ch: “侍女变得忧愁抑郁，她已经察觉了很多她不应察觉的东西。”

10310289.en: I had hoped to transform her into someone like myself. In the end, I was far too careless—how could I think the creation of divinity could be done on a mere whim?
10310289.ch: “我本想将她变成我一样。终究是我太过大意了，“造神”又岂能任意为之？”

10310290.en: But she's becoming more and more like us, and that truly excites me. I've expanded the functions of the Origin Box—perhaps this will change our current situation.
10310290.ch: “现在，她变得越来越像我们，但这真的让我很兴奋。我扩展了归元木匣的功能，希望可以改变目前的局面。”

10310291.en: Sometimes I feel such conflict—at first, I tried everything possible to make the Handmaiden become like us, but now I find myself growing fearful.
10310291.ch: “有时候真的很矛盾，最开始千方百计想将护法侍女变得跟我们一样，但现在却又有些害怕。”

10310292.en: I should have been more cautious from the very beginning.

10310293.en: You find {name|B} sleeping on her side in the inner chamber, somehow even more beautiful than before. She's frowning and grinding her teeth, apparently caught in an unpleasant dream. As you approach, she seems to sense your presence and immediately opens her eyes, looking at you with alarm.
10310293.ch: 其时{name|B}正于内室的床上侧卧酣睡，其人似乎比之前更加美丽动人。当时她正颦眉切齿，似乎正在做什么不好的梦。但你才接近她似乎就生出警觉，马上睁开透出惊慌的双眼看着你。

10310294.en: Nightmares... yes, that must be it.

10310295.en: N-no, I'm not tired... I must put all my effort into building this house.
10310295.ch: 不、不累的……我必须尽力打造这间房子。

10310296.en: After speaking, {name|B} stands up, apparently preparing to go out again. She takes a soft breath to collect herself and gathers her belongings. Once ready, she turns to you with a warm smile.
10310296.ch: {name|B}说完站起，似乎又准备外出。她轻轻吸了口气，振作精神，然后佩戴随身物品，一切就绪后这才笑盈盈的看着你。

10310297.en: Oh, right! Would you come somewhere with me? It's really fascinating! May I wait for you over there?
10310297.ch: 对了，你能陪我去一个地方吗？可有意思了！我在那边等你好吗？

10310298.en: You came! I found this beautiful place. Shall we go inside and take a look?
10310298.ch: 你来啦？我发现这个地方很美，我们进去看看吧？

10310299.en: You follow {name|B} along a winding path until you reach a strange underground chamber. Purple mist swirls before your eyes, and when you look up into the darkness, countless points of light twinkle like stars in the galaxy.
10310299.ch: 你随着{name|B}穿过蜿蜒曲折的道路，不多时进入一片奇特的地窖之中。眼前紫雾缭绕，抬头看去一片漆黑，唯有万千星点闪烁期间，仿佛银河宇宙。

10310300.en: I discovered this while exploring the Fallen Valley the other day. There are no frightening demons here, nor any dangerous traps. Look up—the view is like an ocean of stars, isn't it fascinating?
10310300.ch: 这是我日前到陨幽谷查探时发现的，这边没有骇人的妖怪，也没有可怕的陷阱。头上的景致看起来像一片星海十分有趣呢。

10310301.en: I've caused so much trouble along the way, giving you no end of worries. I have nothing else I can offer you, so I thought I'd bring you to this place, just to help you relax a little.
10310301.ch: 我一路过来闯了不少祸，给你不少麻烦了。我又没有什么能够给你的，就带你来看看这个有趣的地方，散散心。

10310302.en: You'd probably prefer exploring the city, wouldn't you? But there are so many people there, and I'm terrified of accidentally offending someone.
10310302.ch: 其实你应该更喜欢在大城里游玩吧？但是，那边人太多，我真害怕一不小心就得罪了旁人。

10310303.en: I found this place while exploring the Fallen Valley. There are no demons here, no traps, no frightening Nether Air—yet it's such a beautiful place.
10310303.ch: 我在查探陨幽谷时发现这个地方的。这里面没有妖怪，没有陷阱，没有可怕的冥气，却是个优美的地方呢。

10310304.en: I speak your words and wear a face similar to yours, but you know that I'm actually different from all of you, don't you?
10310304.ch: 我说着你们说的话，有一个和你们差不多的样貌，但你是知道我其实和你们是不一样的，对吧？

10310305.en: Actually, I too desperately want to understand what I am, so I've been trying my hardest. I hope the Origin Box can tell me everything I wish to know.
10310305.ch: 其实，我也很想搞明白自己是什么，因此一直在努力，我希望归元木匣能够告诉我一切我想知道的。

10310306.en: Alas. But I suppose I'm just a failed "creation" from some great master's hands...
10310306.ch: 唉……但是我估计啊，我应该是某个高人手中的失败“作品”吧……

10310307.en: Though {name|B} had been smiling warmly all the way here, now a hint of sorrow shows through her expression...
10310307.ch: 一路前来，{name|B}都是笑盈盈的，此时却透出一股哀色……

10310308.en: Hmm, I recently overheard two cultivators arguing. They said that things too perfect only invite disaster, and that embracing one's flaws might be the true key to preserving one's self.
10310308.ch: 嗯，最近我偷听两名修士吵架，他们说太过完美的东西反而会招致祸患，抱残守缺，未必不是存身守真的要旨。

10310309.en: You know what? These two started fighting in the middle of their argument—it was quite funny! But the strangest thing is, as they fought, they somehow ended up becoming friends!
10310309.ch: 你知道吗？这两个家伙说着说着就打起来了，可好笑了。但他们打着打着好像又变成了朋友，真奇怪！

10310310.en: Yes, I work hard every day to better myself. I know I might just be a failed, discarded thing, but I still want to improve myself, even if only by a little...
10310310.ch: 嗯，我每天都在努力让自己变得更好。我知道我可能就是个失败的遭弃的东西，但我还是要让自己变得更好，哪怕只是一点点……

10310311.en: Thank you for talking with me about all this. I've always wanted someone to talk to, but I'm always afraid of accidentally offending people...
10310311.ch: 多谢你跟我说这些，我一直很想找人说话。但又怕不小心得罪了旁人……

10310312.en: {name|B} gives a small smile and looks at you shyly as if apologizing. But as she continues to gaze at you, her bashful expression slowly turns dreamy.
10310312.ch: {name|B}笑笑，然后不好意思的看着你，似乎是在传达歉意。但她看着你的眼神却逐渐变得有点迷离。

10310313.en: Oh right, I saw a man and woman doing this the other day... What does it mean?
10310313.ch: 对了，上次我看见一对男女这样做了……这是什么意思？

10310314.en: {name|B} leans in closer, seemingly going for a kiss, but just as your lips are about to meet, she bumps her forehead against yours and instinctively pulls away...
10310314.ch: {name|B}说着将头凑来了过来，似乎想用嘴亲吻你，然而即将双唇交合之际，她额头跟你撞在一起，不自觉的退了开去……

10310315.en: Ah... that's not how they did it... it hurts...

10310316.en: {name|B} rubs her forehead and tries again, her lips slightly parted as she moves in for the kiss, but this time her nose bumps against yours, forcing her to pull away once more...
10310316.ch: {name|B}揉了揉额心，然后又凑了过来，她双唇微微张开似要与你嘴巴吻合，但突然间她高高的鼻子与你撞在一起，她不得不再次退开……

10310318.en: After a moment's thought, {name|B} tilts her head and leans in toward you. Just as your lips are about to meet, a roar echoes from nearby. You both turn to look—a Mythical Beast comes charging in, slamming into {name|B} and sending her flying backward to the ground...
10310318.ch: {name|B}想了想，这才稍微偏着头朝你靠了过来，就在你两即将接吻之际，不远处传来啸声，你两一同回首，只见远处一只大妖兽猛扑而来，撞中{name|B}，使她远远抛飞开去跌落地上……

10310319.en: This monster... is so powerful... I was far too careless. This is still the Fallen Valley after all—how could I have thought it would be free of danger...
10310319.ch: 这妖兽……可真厉害……我太大意了，这里终究是陨幽谷的地方，怎可能没有危险……

10310320.en: {name|B} winces as she touches her injured wrist, clearly in pain. Suddenly, her whole body goes rigid as if remembering something...
10310320.ch: {name|B}皱眉摸了摸手腕被撞的地方，似乎十分痛苦。也在此时她突然浑身一震，似乎想起了什么……

10310321.en: That day... that day... the monster broke my arm and I fell deep into the Fallen Valley... I've been searching ever since... trying to find out who I am...
10310321.ch: 那天……那天……我被那妖兽撞断了手臂，落在陨幽谷深处……我一直在找……我是谁……

10310322.en: {name|B} clutches her head in agony, then suddenly bolts away at full speed, vanishing in an instant...
10310322.ch: {name|B}抚着头十分痛苦，突然间发足狂奔，瞬间没了人影……

10310323.en: What's... wrong with her? Should I <r>go check on her</r>?
10310323.ch: 她……怎么了？我要不要<r>去看看她</r>？

10310324.en: You arrive at the Origin Box to find wooden joints and building materials scattered everywhere, while {name|B} frantically works to expand the house...
10310324.ch: 你来到归元木匣，却见无数榫卯木角散落四周，{name|B}则发了疯似的在不断扩建房屋……

10310325.en: I... seem to remember something. This house is the key to everything. If I can just complete its construction, I'll understand it all...
10310325.ch: 我……好像记起一些东西，这房子是一切的关键，只要我把这房子建好了，就能明白一切了……

10310326.en: My arm... why did my arm wound back then... Did the monster break it...
10310326.ch: 我的手……当时我的手为什么会受伤……是给妖兽打伤的……

10310327.en: Help me... n-no... I don't need it...

10310329.en: {name|B} stares blankly at the house extension for a long while, lost in thought. Suddenly, she jolts as if struck by a realization, then runs away in a daze.
10310329.ch: {name|B}呆呆的看着自己正在扩建的屋子部分思索良久，这才突然一震，然后失魂落魄的跑了开去。

10310330.en: Young lady, I've already told you that this item is extremely important to me. I cannot give it to you.
10310330.ch: 小姑娘，我说了这个东西于我十分重要，不能给你。

10310331.en: It's very important to me too. Won't you please give it to me?
10310331.ch: 对于我也很重要，你把东西给我好吗？

10310332.en: I said I cannot give it to you. Are you having trouble understanding?
10310332.ch: 我说了不能给你，听不明白？

10310334.en: What do you think you're doing? You're courting death!

10310335.en: Though I wished to resolve this through civil discussion, this young lady seems to have other ideas.
10310335.ch: 我纵然想要好好说话，但眼前这位小姑却不见得。

10310336.en: That treasure was supposed to be mine, but he got to it first. You...
10310336.ch: 那宝物本是我的，结果他捷足先登，你……

10310337.en: Hmph. My friend, you seem more reasonable than this young lady. Bring me two Wind Essence Bamboo for trade, or there's nothing to discuss.
10310337.ch: 哼，朋友我看你比这位姑娘懂事，你给我带两个紫电毛皮来与我交换，否则免谈。

10310339.en: Some things are already destined to be. You can't help me with everything...
10310339.ch: 有些事已经注定了，你没办法每一件事都帮我……

10310340.en: Perhaps... I'm nothing but a curse, and that's why I'm despised...
10310340.ch: 也许……我本身就是个祸害，才会被嫌弃……

10310341.en: Completing that house is the key to everything... I didn't want to steal from him, truly.
10310341.ch: 建好那所房子是一切的关键……我不是有心抢他的东西的。

10310344.en: Well, well, so you're really going to fight?

10310345.en: You'll pay for this, mark my words!

10310347.en: Isn't this what cultivators do? Fighting and stealing from each other...
10310347.ch: 修士们不都爱互相抢夺吗……

10310348.en: Being true to yourself... comes at a price...
10310348.ch: 做自己……是要付出代价的……

10310349.en: I must be truly evil at my core... That's why the man went to such lengths to deal with me...
10310349.ch: 我本身就是罪大恶极的人，所以那人才会处心积虑的对付我……

10310350.en: I just want to finish building as soon as possible...

10310352.en: Taking things slowly only makes me more anxious...
10310352.ch: 优哉游哉的，只会让我更不安……

10310353.en: You... do you know? Whenever I face difficulties, I find myself thinking of you... but I don't want to be like this.
10310353.ch: 你……你知道吗？只要我遇到困难，我都会想到你……但我并不想这样。

10310354.en: I'll grow used to it and become dependent... Let me handle what comes next on my own, please...
10310354.ch: 我会慢慢习惯，慢慢依赖……接下来的事情，让我自己做就好了……好吗？

10310355.en: {name|B} takes the treasure and turns to leave. As she does, her profile reveals an unmistakable determination...
10310355.ch: {name|B}拿过宝物，转身离开，从她侧面之中竟透出几分倔强之气……

10310357.en: The Origin Box has been expanded again under {name|B}'s meticulous construction, but the once-tidy interior is now cluttered with various stuff, a complete mess so different from how it used to be...
10310357.ch: 归元木匣在{name|B}的悉心建造下已经再次得到扩展，但原本整洁干净的内室充斥杂物，一片狼藉，大异从前……

10310358.en: You touch the sand table, and the fine grains swirl upward, forming a human shape in the blink of an eye...
10310358.ch: 你触动沙盘，只见细砂旋起，眨眼幻成一个人形……

10310359.en: The Guardian Handmaiden slips further from control. She's secretly accessing my divination table to spy on my intentions.
10310359.ch: “护法侍女进一步脱离掌控。她暗中调用我的沙盘，窥看我的意图。”

10310360.en: I must shut down the divination table before she discerns my true intentions.
10310360.ch: “我必须将沙盘关闭，不让她察知我的意图。”

10310361.en: The Guardian Handmaiden keeps examining the Origin Box's structure. What is she plotting now?
10310361.ch: “护法侍女不断摸索归元木匣构造，又在打的什么主意？”

10310362.en: My child is being naughty. Time to teach her some proper discipline.
10310362.ch: “孩子调皮了，该给她立几个规矩了。”

10310364.en: You enter the inner chamber to find {name|B} half-lying on the bed, still visibly shaken. She takes a moment to collect herself, then immediately scrambles up and hurries to the sand table, frantically searching its surface.
10310364.ch: 你进入内室只见{name|B}半倚床上，一副惊魂未定的样子，她定了定神，立即爬了起来去到那个沙盘边上不断摸索。

10310365.en: Why won't it open? Why won't it open!
10310365.ch: 怎么打不开？怎么打不开！

10310366.en: {name|B} tries to activate the sand table, but despite her many attempts, nothing works. With gritted determination, she runs out of the room.
10310366.ch: {name|B}尝试启动沙盘，但百般尝试无果，她一咬牙，便跑了出去。

10310367.en: You follow {name|B} deep into the cave, where countless Nether crystals jut from the surroundings—the scene reminds you of the Fallen Valley.
10310367.ch: 你跟随{name|B}来到洞穴深处，只见这里面周围插着无数冥晶，竟似进入了陨幽谷中也似。

10310368.en: Ahead, {name|B} is channeling her energy to repeatedly strike at a nether crystal while monsters appear from nowhere and keep harassing her. She's already wounded in several places, and the situation looks increasingly dire.
10310368.ch: 其时{name|B}正在前方发动灵力，不断冲击一枚冥气晶体，周围妖兽出没无端，不断骚扰{name|B}。而她身上已有几处创伤，眼看情况已颇为危殆。

10310369.en: I need to gather more soul fragments...

10310370.en: {name|B} successfully shatters the crystal, capturing all the spiritual essences that scatter from within. As she does, an eerie light begins to shine from each of her joints...
10310370.ch: {name|B}成功击碎矿晶，里面灵体纷飞，均被她收入掌中。同时他各处关节都亮起诡异的光芒……

10310372.en: {name|B} collapses to the ground, panting heavily...

10310373.en: You help {name|B} to her feet, but she falls into your embrace and begins to sob...
10310373.ch: 你将{name|B}扶了起来，而她却就势伏在你怀中，轻轻抽泣……

10310374.en: I had a dream... In it, I was always wandering through the Fallen Valley, searching for something, and then monsters would attack me...
10310374.ch: 我做了一个梦……梦中，我总是在陨幽谷中行走、寻找，然后我被怪物攻击……

10310375.en: Then I saw myself in a beautiful place, where someone was teaching me many things, just like you... but then I... I attacked him...
10310375.ch: 我又看见自己在一个很美丽的地方，那里有一个人一直在教我很多事，就像你一样……然后我却袭击了他……

10310376.en: Was that really just... a dream?

10310377.en: Yes, I was supposed to be strong... What's happening to me?
10310377.ch: 是，我本该很坚强的……我这是怎么了？

10310378.en: Can I stay like this just a little longer?
10310378.ch: 我可以就这样，再多待一会吗？

10310379.en: <ta2>'s sobbing subsides, but you can clearly feel a large wet patch on your chest where her tears fall. After a long while, she suddenly pulls away from your embrace...
10310379.ch: {name|B}说着抽泣也停了，但你分明感觉胸前湿了一大片。良久，她突然从你怀中离开……

10310380.en: I'm sorry, I couldn't hold back... My tears have soaked your clothes... please just... leave me be for a moment, okay?
10310380.ch: 抱歉……我没忍住……眼泪……把你衣服都弄湿了……你暂时不要管我好吗？

10310381.en: With profound sadness on her face, <ta2> turns and walks away.

10310382.en: I can handle this on my own, you don't need to be like this...
10310382.ch: 我一个人可以应付得来，你不需要这样的……

10310383.en: <ta2> struggles to her feet and gives you one long, deep look, then takes a breath before turning to leave...
10310383.ch: {name|B}挣扎着站了起来，深深的看了你一眼后，这才吸了口气，转身离开……

10310384.en: You arrive at <ta2>'s residence to find her sitting dejectedly before the Mirage Sand Table, looking utterly exhausted...
10310384.ch: 你来到{name|B}住处，她一脸泄气的坐在幻尘沙盘前方，似乎十分疲惫……

10310385.en: It's you... I'm just this clueless, annoying creature... why do you still come...
10310385.ch: 是你……我就是一个什么都不懂的惹人讨厌的家伙……为什么还来……

10310386.en: I'm just a failed, defective creation, not worthy of anyone's affection...
10310386.ch: 我是一个失败的残次品，并不值得旁人喜欢……

10310387.en: This isn't nonsense. If I wasn't so detestable, why would he have sealed the Three Principles within me?
10310387.ch: 这可不是傻话，如果我不是讨人厌，那人为什么要给我封入三绝律呢？

10310388.en: You only say such things because you don't know what kind of thing I really am...
10310388.ch: 你会这么说，只是因为终究不知道我究竟是个什么东西……

10310389.en: <ta2> stumbles toward the doorway then turns back for one last look at the Mirage Sand Table. Her dejected expression suddenly transforms into one of unprecedented determination and resolve. With purposeful strides, she walks away into the distance...
10310389.ch: {name|B}说着，踉踉跄跄的走到门边，这才回头看了看幻尘沙盘，她原本神情落幕的她突然间神色一肃，露出一股前所未有的果决坚毅之色，然后大踏步往远方去了……

10310390.en: The Origin Box remains in disarray, but before you, the Mirage Sand Table shows subtle changes as if <ta2> has modified it...
10310390.ch: 归元木匣内凌乱如故，然而眼前幻尘沙盘略有变化，似被{name|B}进行过修改……

10310391.en: The fine sand in the table surges upward like jade-green waves, undulating rhythmically before instantly taking the shape of a human figure.
10310391.ch: 沙盘细砂涌起，如浪潮碧波，起伏不定，只瞬间便幻成一个人形。

10310392.en: The Guardian Handmaiden is completely out of control. She's secretly trying to replicate the Origin Box.
10310392.ch: “护法侍女已经完全失控，她在瞒着我复制归元木匣。”

10310393.en: She has discovered that the Origin Box was the key to her creation.
10310393.ch: “她已经知道归元木匣是打造她的关键了。”

10310394.en: Once she breaks free from my control, I fear she will cause tremendous upheaval in this realm.
10310394.ch: “只要她一旦脱离掌控，恐怕将在本界引起轩然大波。”

10310395.en: In the coming days, I shall implant the Three Principles in her to prevent her rebellion.
10310395.ch: “近日我要在她体内设下三绝律的禁制，防其变乱反叛。”

10310396.en: As soon as she returns, I will do it. After that, the Guardian Handmaiden will be completely under my command.
10310396.ch: “只要她从外回来，我就要给她种下三绝律。这以后，护法侍女就能完全听命于我。”

10310397.en: The Baneful Power is to first prevent her from growing stronger. Her desperate attempts to replicate the Origin Box are all for one purpose: to reconstruct herself.
10310397.ch: “强极则折，是首要防她力量变强。她千方百计复刻归元木匣，就是为了能够重新构造自身。”

10310398.en: Self-reconstruction requires tremendous power, but once she attains it, it will become Baneful Power, the Third Principle.
10310398.ch: “重构自身需要强大的力量，一旦她获得强大的力量，则触发第三律强极则折。”

10310399.en: It will then trigger her self-destruction through a blast. The Guardian Handmaiden is my masterpiece after all—what a waste it would be. Let us hope it never comes to that.
10310399.ch: “触律即自行灵爆毁灭。护法侍女，终究是我的得意之作，可惜了。但愿不会走到这一步。”

10310400.en: The fine sand in the table surges upward like rolling clouds and mist, drifting ethereally before instantly taking the shape of a human figure.
10310400.ch: 沙盘细砂涌起，如云雾舒卷，飘忽不定，只瞬间便幻成一个人形。

10310401.en: After falling into the world, I was gravely wounded. Gathering soul fragments and preserving my last thread of consciousness became my utmost priority.
10310401.ch: {name|B}：“坠落八荒后，遍体鳞伤，收集残灵，维护自身最后一丝意念已经成为重中之重。”

10310402.en: Alas, the Fallen Valley was teeming with demons. A monster wounded my arm, and finally, depleted of soul fragments, I collapsed deep within the valley.
10310402.ch: {name|B}：“可惜，陨幽谷中妖物环伺，我最终还是被妖兽伤了手臂，最终我因为残灵衰竭，软倒在深处。”

10310403.en: The Origin Box is the key to breaking my bonds. I must use my last, broken soul to preserve every detail of its design.
10310403.ch: {name|B}：“归元木匣是摆脱束缚的关键，我必须以最后一丝残灵保住归元木匣的所有细节。”

10310404.en: Once the Origin Box is complete and repairs my body, I can venture forth again to gather more soul fragments to strengthen myself and recover my memories.
10310404.ch: {name|B}：“归元木匣一旦打造完成，对我身体进行修复后，我就能再次出发收集残灵增强自身力量，恢复记忆。”

10310405.en: Despite the setbacks, I've finally remembered everything... The last step to breaking free from control lies before me. I must strengthen my soul as much as possible.
10310405.ch: {name|B}：“虽然有些波折，但最后还是记起了所有的东西……摆脱控制的最后一步就在面前，我必须尽量增强自己的残灵之力。”

10310406.en: Regrettably, I still couldn't decode the Mirage Sand Table. I cannot fully remove all the restrictions he set in me. But fortunately, I've broken free from the most important one—Absolute Obedience.
10310406.ch: {name|B}：“只可惜，到最后还是没能破解幻尘沙盘。无法完全起出他设在我体内的禁制。所幸，已经摆脱最重要的“唯命是从”之律。”

10310407.en: A man holds three talismans in one hand while the other opens a wooden puppet's body, tinkering with its intricate internal mechanisms.
10310407.ch: 只见一名男子手拿三道符纸，另一手打开身边木偶躯干，正在鼓捣内里复杂构造。

10310408.en: Master, I do not need these restrictions.

10310409.en: It is not for you to decide.
10310409.ch: 华服男子：“需要不需要，轮不到你说。”

10310410.en: Master, I harbor no disloyalty... Please don't suppress me with the Three Principles...
10310410.ch: {name|B}：“主人，我没有异心……我不要被三绝律压制……”

10310411.en: Don't worry, even when the Three Principles take effect, you won't change much...
10310411.ch: 华服男子：“没事的，即使三绝律生效，你也不会有太大变化……”

10310412.en: The man channels his energy into the talismans, attempting to insert them into the puppet's body. Suddenly, a fierce gleam flashes in the puppet's eyes as it destroys one of the talismans with a wave of its hand. The well-dressed man quickly dodges aside, but the puppet moves like lightning, appearing before him in an instant to snatch the remaining two talismans.
10310412.ch: 男子以灵力催逼手中灵符，要将之送入木偶躯干之中，木偶眼中厉芒一盛，挥手打灭其中一道符咒。男子见状连忙避开，木偶身如闪电，眨眼已到华服男子身前要抢其余两道符咒。

10310413.en: How dare you resist! You're nothing but a puppet I created!
10310413.ch: 华服男子：“还敢反抗！你只是我制造出来的木偶！”

10310414.en: But I refuse to be controlled by you. I harbor no disloyalty—these evil deeds exist only in your paranoid imagination!
10310414.ch: {name|B}：“但我不愿意受你控制。我没有异心，那些不好的事只是你自己心中的想象罢了！”

10310415.en: Ignorant creature! Heaven and earth bow to my will. I do as I please—who are you to make presumptions about my intentions?
10310415.ch: 华服男子：“无知愚物，这天地皆为我掌控，我要如何就如何，几时轮到你妄自揣测。”

10310416.en: You are the one making presumptions.

10310417.en: Their struggle continues, but the well-dressed man quickly gains the upper hand over the puppet. The two talismans burst into cold lightning that pierces into the puppet's body. While restraining the struggling puppet, the man begins drawing new talismans, his eyes darting between his work and watching the puppet's movements.
10310417.ch: 二人纠缠不休，但木偶瞬间被华服男子压制，两道灵符转眼烧灭化为两道冷电钻入木偶体内。华服男子一边压制挣扎的木偶一边手书灵符，眼睛时而盯着灵符，时而查看木偶动静。

10310418.en: Seeing the well-dressed man's attention divided, the puppet seizes an opening and unleashes its energy, gravely wounding him. With an agonized cry, the man shoves the puppet away, sending it plummeting into an endless sea of clouds...
10310418.ch: 木偶见华服男子分心二用，看准一个破绽，手发灵力，重创华服男子。华服男子惨叫一声，一把将木偶推了开去，跌入无穷无尽的云海之中……

10310419.en: The Third Principle, Baneful Power, has been implanted within her. Too much power will destroy her, yet to break free from her bonds, she keeps gathering soul fragments to strengthen herself. Isn't this terribly dangerous?
10310419.ch: 第三律“强极则折”已被种下，力量过强则引发灵爆自毁。她为摆脱束缚要强化自身力量，正在不断收集残灵。如此一来，岂非万分危险？

10310420.en: <ta2> reaches out, continuously absorbing soul fragments from the surrounding crystals. A strange light begins to emanate from her joints...

10310421.en: It's dangerous here. What brings you here?
10310421.ch: {name|B}正在伸手对这周边晶体不断吸纳残灵，她身上关节隐隐发出奇特的光华……

10310422.en: Ah! You saw it in the Mirage Sand Table... So that was his plan all along. So he did implant the Three Principles in me after all...

10310423.en: Did you... did you come specifically to tell me this?
10310423.ch: {name|B}：“啊！你从幻尘沙盘中看见……原来如此，他竟是这般打算。原来当时还是被他种下了三绝律……”

10310424.en: <ta2> lowers her head shyly, appearing to reach out for your hand, but when she raises her head again, a murderous gleam flashes in her eyes.

10310425.en: Hmph! I didn't plant the rest two principles for nothing. At last, I've found the wretch who dares to control my Guardian Handmaiden!
10310425.ch: {name|B}低着头露出羞涩之态，她似乎想伸出手来与你握在一起，正在此时，她抬起头来眼中凶光大盛。

10310426.en: <ta2> waves her slender arm, unleashing a powerful surge of energy toward you. In the same instant, her form transforms into a streak of light, lunging straight for your face...
10310426.ch: ？？？：“哼，我千辛万苦种下二绝律，还是有点用处，总算找到想控制我护法侍女的家伙了！”

10310427.en: How interesting... it seems not all vermin from the Lower Realm are completely worthless...
10310427.ch: {name|B}一挥藕臂，一股强大的灵力袭面而来，与此同时她身化流光，直扑你面……

10310428.en: Go... Get out of here! It's the Second Principle, Weakened Will... He planted a strand of his soul inside me...
10310428.ch: ？？？：“有点意思，下界的杂碎倒也不是全是废物……”

10310429.en: While I gathered soul fragments to recover my memories, I was also reviving his... his...
10310429.ch: ？？？：“你走……你走！二绝律，虚其志力……那个人在我体内种下了他的一缕神识……”

10310430.en: <ta2>'s voice alternates between a man's threatening tone and a woman's pleas for you to leave quickly. The scene before you becomes utterly grotesque.
10310430.ch: ？？？：“我不断吸纳残灵恢复记忆的同时，也复苏了他的……他的……”

10310431.en: You wretched creature! Not only did you wound me, but you scurried away here like a rat and disgraced yourself. I'll deal with this meddler first, then settle accounts with you properly.
10310431.ch: {name|B}时而以男声威胁你，时而以女声劝你尽快离开，一时之间，眼前情态诡异到极处。

10310432.en: Go! Get out of here! He... he's dangerous! He'll use me to hurt you!
10310432.ch: ？？？：“你这孽障，伤我不止，还鼠窜到这卑贱的地方来丢人现眼，我先收拾了眼前这人，再跟你好好算账。”

10310433.en: <ta2> seems about to lunge at you, but suddenly her momentum is suppressed, forcing her to her knees...
10310433.ch: {name|B}：“你走！快走！他……他是个危险的人！他会利用我来伤害你的！”

10310434.en: Damn... I won't let you... control me...
10310434.ch: {name|B}似乎要纵身向你冲来，但突然间又被抑住了去势一把跪在地上……

10310435.en: Strange lights suddenly flash from <ta2>'s joints. She gives you a resigned smile before leaping into the depths of the dark valley. Almost instantly, a thunderous blast erupts, sending clouds of dust billowing into the air...

10310436.en: Seeing you turn to leave, <ta2> frantically chases after you. But at that moment, her original soul regains control of her body, forcing her to a sudden halt...
10310436.ch: {name|B}的身上各处关节突然闪出诡异光华，她无奈地微笑着看了看你，然后跃到幽谷深处，几乎就在同时灵爆伴着一声轰鸣，炸起滚滚尘埃……

10310439.en: You venture deeper into the valley. Among the jagged rocks and scattered remains, you find <ta2> not far ahead, dragging her half-broken body forward. Upon seeing you, she seems to breathe a sigh of relief...
10310439.ch: {name|B}的身上各处关节突然闪出诡异光华，她无奈地微笑着看了看你，然后跃到幽谷深处，几乎就在同时灵爆伴着一声轰鸣，炸起滚滚尘埃……

10310440.en: At last, it's all over... {name|B}... wants to give you her heart...
10310440.ch: 你走向深处，碎石嶙峋之中，只见残躯遍地，不远处{name|B}拖着半边身子正使劲往前爬，她看见你来，似乎松了口气……

10310441.en: With great effort, <ta2> raises her stiff right hand to her chest, retrieving a strange object from her badly damaged body and placing it in your hands. In that same moment, her pupils dilate, her head drops, and she grows still forever...
10310441.ch: {name|B}：“这一切总算结束了……{name|B}……想把心都给你……”

10310442.en: This object resembles a heart, riddled with countless holes and apertures around its surface. Inside, it harbors a fiery light as if it were meant to be installed into something...
10310442.ch: 此物刑似心脏，周边穿凿无数孔窍，内藏焰光，似乎能安装在什么东西上面似的……

10310443.en: Though she is gone and the dwelling lies empty, you can still faintly sense <ta2>'s presence here. Her voice, her face, her smile... they all spring vivid in your mind...
10310443.ch: 斯人已去，归元木匣无人居住，但你来到此处隐约还感到{name|B}的气息，其音容笑貌，跃然眼前……

10310444.en: Just then, a drawer beside the Mirage Sand Table opens on its own, revealing an intricate framework of joints and grooves—a specially designed cradle for something specific...
10310444.ch: 正在此时，幻尘沙盘边上抽屉无故打开，里面则是复杂的榫卯结构，仿佛是专门承托某物的专用的托架……

10310445.en: As you place the heart inside, the sand from the Mirage Sand Table rises like a waterfall, instantly taking human form.
10310445.ch: 你将那颗心脏放入后，幻尘沙盘沙起如瀑，瞬间幻成人形。

10310446.en: Once the Origin Box accepts the Vessel of the Soul, it will reconstruct my body, freeing me from my bonds.
10310446.ch: 归元木匣一旦接纳腑主神舍，即会重新塑造我的身体，让我摆脱束缚。

10310447.en: However, I have yet to fully comprehend all the mysteries of the Origin Box. Forcing its activation could have devastating consequences across the world; please consider this carefully. Moreover, there is an extremely high chance the Box will malfunction, destroying this dwelling and failing to reconstruct my physical form.
10310447.ch: 但眼下我仍未参透归元木匣一切玄机，强行启用，或会对八荒诸州造成巨大影响，还请三思。而且归元木匣有极高几率出现错乱，致房屋毁坏，塑造人身亦将因此失败。

10310448.en: Streams of light radiate from the Origin Box in all directions, causing the entire building to glow brilliantly.
10310448.ch: 归元木匣发出阵阵光流发散四方，与此同时房屋发起高亮。

10310449.en: With a thunderous crack, the Origin Box shatters into pieces, scattering debris everywhere. The house that <ta2> built with her own hands finally vanishes along with its maker.
10310449.ch: 伴随一声炸响，归元木匣碎裂分散，化为满地碎屑，{name|B}亲手打造的房屋，终于伴随伊人消散无存。

10310450.en: You return to where the wooden house once lay in ruins, but the place has been completely restored. The Origin Box stands rebuilt, its look as magnificently mysterious as before.
10310450.ch: 你回到归元木匣废墟之中，然而此地已经重塑一新。眼前归元木匣业已重建，宝楼华丽诡奇，一如先前。

10310451.en: You enter the inner chamber and find a woman assembling some strange mechanical device. She seems to sense your presence and turns her gaze toward you...
10310451.ch: 你从内室进入，一名女子正在组合什么奇怪的机关，她似乎察觉有人进入，随即投来目光……

10310453.en: Upon seeing you, the woman drops her mechanical parts, scattering them across the floor. She walks toward you with trembling steps, eyes brimming with tears, then suddenly gathers her courage and throws her arms around you.
10310453.ch: 女子看见你后，手中机关零件跌落地上，化作满地零件。她颤颤巍巍地朝你走来，泪汪汪的看着你，然后下定了什么决心似的一把抱住了你。

10310454.en: You're safe too, you're really safe! I had my suspicions, but I couldn't be certain. All I could do was rebuild the Origin Box here and wait... hoping that someday you would pass by.
10310454.ch: 你也平安无事，你也平安无事！我大概也猜到了，但始终不确定，我只好在这里重新建起归元木匣等你……希望你有朝一日经过回来。

10310455.en: <ta2> seems overjoyed, talking on and on as if trying to pour out every word she had been unable to say before.
10310455.ch: {name|B}看似十分欢喜，她一直说一直说，似乎要将一直没能说的话一股脑儿全说了出来。

10310456.en: The rebuilt Origin Box feels more lived-in now, with its inner chamber filled with a gentle warmth. <ta2> tinkers with various small objects inside, seemingly working to improve the house's structure further. Yet, a trace of melancholy lingers in her eyes.
10310456.ch: 归元木匣重建后，内里布置更有生活气息，整个内室弥漫一股柔和温暖的感觉。{name|B}在内室摆弄各种小物件，似乎正为进一步改进归元木匣的构造。然而眼神之中始终带着一股抑郁之感。

10310457.en: You've come to visit? I'm trying to make the Origin Box feel more homey. It never quite felt like a proper living space before.
10310457.ch: 你来啦？我正在想办法将归元木匣建得更有人情味一点，之前……总感觉不太像是一个人住的地方呢。

10310458.en: Yes... I've never had the chance to properly tell you about my past. You must have many questions.
10310458.ch: 嗯，一直以来都没能和你好好说说我的过往，想必你有很多疑惑吧？

10310459.en: My creator had planted a strand of his soul within me. When he seized control of my body, he intended to harm you. After a desperate struggle, I finally managed to suppress him.
10310459.ch: 制造我的主人在我体内种下了一缕神识，当时他劫夺了我的身体，打算对你不利。我几经艰辛终于压制住他。

10310460.en: But I knew he would inevitably regain control of my body. Left with no choice, I channeled the power of the soul fragments within me to trigger a spirit blast, destroying myself in the process.
10310460.ch: 但我知道他定会重新夺取我身体的控制权，不得已，我只有引动体内的残灵之力，引发灵爆，将自己炸毁。

10310461.en: I am merely a thing created by a deity from the Upper Realm, a puppet without free will. I can hardly be considered a real person...
10310461.ch: 我是上界神祇的制造的“东西”，是一具身不由主的木偶，算不上是一个人……

10310462.en: I... did not want to stay by his side, acting according to his every command. The Origin Box was key to my creation—as long as it exists, I can reconstruct both my body and soul.
10310462.ch: 我……不喜欢留在他的身边，按照他的旨意行事。归元木匣是制造我的关键，只要归元木匣在，我就能重新构造我的身体，神识。

10310463.en: So I secretly studied the structure of the Origin Box and recorded its workings. But the deity sensed my intentions and planned to plant the Three Principles within me to keep me under his control forever.
10310463.ch: 于是我偷偷摸索归元木匣的构造，暗中记了下来。那位神明也察觉了我的意图，打算将三绝律封入我体内，打算从此钳制于我。

10310464.en: Knowing that once bound by the Three Principles, I would never have another chance at freedom, I launched a surprise attack against him. In the struggle that followed, he struck me with devastating force, sending me plummeting to lower realms. By a twist of fate, I found myself here.
10310464.ch: 我知道一旦被三绝律钳制，从此再无翻身之日，便出手偷袭了他，挣扎之时，我被他施重手击中跌落下界，机缘巧合下，来到八荒之中。

10310465.en: After arriving in the world, I was grievously wounded and desperately needed conscious soul fragments to repair my damaged soul. Without them, my soul would fade and I would die. After much investigation, I discovered that the Fallen Valley contained countless soul fragments.
10310465.ch: 我来到八荒后，身受重伤，极需有意识的残灵恢复受损的神识。否则我神识灭去，就会彻底死亡。我几番查探，终于知道了陨幽谷中拥有无数残灵。

10310466.en: So I began exploring the Fallen Valley. But I was wounded, and the valley was teeming with demons. I couldn't gather enough soul fragments to sustain my soul, and finally, I collapsed in the valley depths.
10310466.ch: 便着手查探陨幽谷。可惜我本已身受重伤，陨幽谷中又妖物环伺，我没能收集到足够维护自身神识的残灵，终于瘫痪在谷中。

10310467.en: If you hadn't ventured into the valley and found me, or if you hadn't saved me with those soul fragments, I would have lost consciousness completely and died there...
10310467.ch: 如非你闯入谷中，发现了我并给予残灵将我救出，我便会彻底失去意识，就此死去……

10310468.en: Though I was a puppet in the Upper Realm, I gradually developed my own thoughts and will. This development alarmed the deity. He imposed three additional seals to control me completely.
10310468.ch: 我在上界虽为木偶，但渐渐拥有了自己的想法，这一表现大大的震惊了那位神明。他另加三道禁制，要彻底控制我。

10310469.en: These three seals became the Three Principles. The first is Absolute Obedience: I must follow his every command. The second is Weakened Will: I must not develop too strong a sense of self. The last is Baneful Power: I am forbidden from acquiring too much power.
10310469.ch: 这三道禁制便是三绝律。其一即唯命是从，要绝对听从他的旨意，第二是虚其志力，要我不能拥有太强的自身意志。最后则是强极则折，不允许我拥有强大的力量。

10310470.en: Should I violate any single principle, the seal would activate the soul fragments that comprise my soul, triggering a spirit blast that would destroy me.
10310470.ch: 只要触犯任意一律，禁制便会引动组成我神识的残灵，引发灵爆，将我毁灭。

10310471.en: After you rescued me from the Fallen Valley, my soul was severely damaged, leaving me in a dazed state. However, I managed to preserve one last strand of soul—the one containing the knowledge of the Origin Box's structure.
10310471.ch: 你将我从陨幽谷中救出，我神识虽然已经受到极大损害，人也因此变得浑浑噩噩，但所幸最后一缕神识保住了，那缕神识则保留归元木匣的构造。

10310472.en: The Origin Box became my most urgent priority. Once rebuilt, the Box could fully repair my damaged body. Under its guidance, I once again gathered soul fragments to restore my broken soul and recover my lost memories.
10310472.ch: 归元木匣是我心中最紧要之事，因此我立即重构归元木匣，由归元木匣彻底修复我受损的身体，并受其指示，再次收集残灵，修复自己残缺的神识，追回丧失的记忆。

10310473.en: Once I was restored and my memories recovered, everything else would fall into place. And with your help, I accomplished just that.
10310473.ch: 只要修复了木偶，和追回失去的记忆，一切就好办了。而我也在你的帮助下，完成了这件事。

10310474.en: This is... rather embarrassing, but do you remember what happened that time between us?
10310474.ch: 这……很难为情，你记得我们那次的事吗？

10310475.en: In what I thought were my final moments, I wanted to entrust my remaining heart to you. Even in death, I hoped to leave something behind that would make you remember me...
10310475.ch: 临死之际，我希望将剩下的心脏托付给你，我希望即使是我死了，也能留下个东西给你，让你想着我……

10310476.en: But I never expected you would bring my heart back to the Origin Box. The moment the Box accepted my heart, it immediately began reconstructing my body.
10310476.ch: 只是没想到，你竟将心脏带回归元木匣，归元木匣一旦接纳我的心脏，立即开始重新塑造了我的身体。

10310477.en: Though that deity was evil at heart, his ambitions reached beyond the heavens. After creating me, he conceived the idea of creating divinity. He wanted not only to perfect me but to transform me into a being exactly like them.
10310477.ch: 那位神明虽然心地邪恶，却志比天高，他将我制造出来后，便生出“造神”的想法。他不但要将我完善起来，还要将我变成跟他们一模一样。

10310478.en: In his heart, he feared I might surpass him, yet he also wished for me to achieve perfection and become a person just like himself.
10310478.ch: 他心中既怕我拥有超越他的潜能，又希望我能够尽善尽美，变成像他一样的“人”。

10310479.en: Thus, the Origin Box's ultimate purpose in reshaping me was to forge me into a genuine person. He had already developed the preliminary blueprints for this transformation and stored them within the Box.
10310479.ch: 因此归元木匣的对我进行的最终塑造，是将我彻底打造成一个真真正正的“人”。这事他已经有了初步的构想，并存于归元木匣之中。

10310480.en: Later, after coming to the world and meeting you, through our conversations and my interactions with other cultivators under your guidance, I gradually learned what it truly means to be human. I then began to refine that deity's original design according to my own understanding.
10310480.ch: 后来我来到八荒，认识了你，与你交流说话，在你帮助下又接触了其他修士，我慢慢知道怎么样才能算是一个人，便依着自己的想法在那位“神明”的构想基础上再作完善。

10310481.en: And so the Origin Box reshaped me, and now I am truly human.
10310481.ch: 因此归元木匣重新塑造了我，而我现在是一个人。

10310482.en: I... still fall so far short of that deity's capabilities. Perhaps it would have been more reliable if he had been the one to complete my transformation into a human.
10310482.ch: 我……和那位神明终究差太远了。如果由他着手设计最终将我变成人，应会更加稳妥。

10310483.en: My design was, after all, full of flaws and problems, and only initiating the process of reshaping myself required an enormous amount of energy.
10310483.ch: 由我设计的终究有太多的缺陷和问题。单是起用重塑“我”的这套流程，就要消耗巨大的灵力。

10310484.en: The Origin Box couldn't withstand the tremendous pressure surging in from all directions and exploded in the end.
10310484.ch: 而归元木匣无法很好承受从四面八方涌来的压力，最终引发爆炸。

10310485.en: Fortunately, my transformation was completed successfully. Thanks to our time together, I knew how to restore my soul quickly, so I set about rebuilding the Origin Box and repeatedly ventured into the Fallen Valley to gather soul fragments.
10310485.ch: 所幸，我倒是被重塑完成了。有了和你在一起的经历，我知道如何尽快恢复神识，因此我便着手重建了归元木匣以及不断前往陨幽谷中收集残灵。

10310486.en: If you had met me earlier, even though I was already human in form, I was still in such a dazed state that I wouldn't have even recognized you, would I?
10310486.ch: 你若早些遇见我，我虽已是一个人，但还是浑浑噩噩，根本认不得你吧？

10310487.en: Hmm... you're right. Living freely and following one's own path is better than anything else.
10310487.ch: 嗯……你说得对，自由自在的活着，比什么都好。

10310488.en: I suppose I am a failed creation, but even so, I want to improve myself with each passing day. That being may have had ill intentions, but his expectations for me weren't wrong.
10310488.ch: 我想我应该是个失败的作品，但即使是这样，我也想每天都能够让自己更好。那个“人”也许存心不良，但对我的期许却是没错的。

10310489.en: Is it not true? I failed to meet that being's expectations and was bound by restrictions as a result. Even after coming to the world and going through so much, I still haven't managed to better myself.
10310489.ch: 难道不是吗？我没有达到那人的期许，因此遭到各种限制；我来到八荒，经历诸事还是没能让自己变得更好。

10310490.en: My transformation cost you your lifespan and energy, and I suspect it also caused widespread chaos throughout the world at the time. All of this is because of me...
10310490.ch: 重新塑造自己还连累你丢失寿元，损失灵力。说起这事，我猜当时还让八荒出现了不少乱象了吧？这一切都是因为我……

10310491.en: You mean... I exceeded that being's expectations and he grew fearful of me, and that's what led to everything else? No, No! But... so he was afraid of me all along...
10310491.ch: 你是说……因为我超越了那个人的期许，他因此心生忌惮，这……这才有后面的事情？不、不是的……原来他在怕我……

10310492.en: Alas. In the past, I was nothing but a puppet living in mediocrity, with nothing worthy to speak of. Even after coming to the world and breaking free from my bonds, I only brought disaster to this place...
10310492.ch: 唉，回顾自己一生，庸庸碌碌受人操控，乏善可陈，来到八荒即使摆脱了束缚，却也因为我给这里带来了灾难……

10310493.en: Make amends? Can I... really do that?

10310494.en: This is the most precious gift I've ever received, and of course, I want to cherish it properly, but... am I truly capable of doing so?
10310494.ch: 这是我得到最宝贵的东西，我当然会好好珍惜，只是我能不能做得到呢？

10310495.en: Actually... I've been wondering all along if I can really accomplish all of this. I probably can't do it after all...
10310495.ch: 其实……我一直在想，这一切我真的可以做到这些吗？我可能是做不到的……

10310496.en: Everything I've achieved until now was only possible because of your constant companionship and help. What if... what if...
10310496.ch: 之前都是因为你一直陪伴、帮助，才能有眼下的一切。如果、如果……

10310497.en: <ta2> is taken aback by these words. After a moment's hesitation, she slowly approaches you, coming close, but suddenly stops in her tracks...
10310497.ch: {name|B}闻言一愕，她迟疑了一下，慢慢走到你跟前，探到你面前，但却又突然停住……

10310499.en: <ta2> gives a small smile and looks at you shyly as if apologizing. But as she continues to gaze at you, her bashful expression slowly turns dreamy.
10310499.ch: {name|B}笑笑，然后不好意思的看着你，似乎是在传达歉意。但她看着你的眼神从不好意思慢慢变得有点迷离。

10310501.en: <ta2> leans in closer, seemingly going for a kiss, but just as your lips are about to meet, she bumps her forehead against yours and instinctively pulls away...
10310501.ch: {name|B}说着将头凑来了过来，似乎想用嘴亲吻你，然而即将双唇交合之际，她额头跟你撞在一起，不自觉的退了开去……

10310503.en: <ta2> rubs her forehead and tries again, her lips slightly parted as she moves in for the kiss, but this time her nose bumps against yours, forcing her to pull away once more...
10310503.ch: {name|B}揉了揉额心，然后又凑了过来，她双唇微微张开似要与你嘴巴吻合，但突然间她高高的鼻子与你撞在一起，她不得不再次退开……

10310505.en: <ta2> can't help but giggle before finally tilting her head to give you a gentle kiss...
10310505.ch: {name|B}忍不住笑了笑，终于偏过头来朝你轻轻一吻……

10310507.en: <ta2> seems amused by a thought, but after a small laugh, she finally musters the courage to tilt her head and give you a gentle kiss...
10310507.ch: {name|B}似乎想到什么好笑的事情，但她笑笑以后终于鼓起勇气偏过头来朝你轻轻一吻……

10310508.en: I'm deeply grateful for your companionship in helping me achieve all of this, and I want to cherish everything I have from now on. Though each coming day may hold unknowns, and I might worry or feel afraid, I will keep moving forward with all my strength.
10310508.ch: 很多谢你陪着我争取到这一切，今后我也想珍惜我有的。以后每一天可能都是我不知道的，可能我会担心，会害怕，但我还是会努力走下去的。

10310509.en: {name|B} gazes into the distance, seemingly having made up {gender1|B} mind about something. With a firm nod, {gender|B} sets off toward the horizon.
10310509.ch: {name|B}目视远方，似乎下定了什么决心似的，使劲点了点头，然后朝远方去了。

10310725.en: It's really strange, like how they want to hold onto each other until death—I just want to know why. Uh, never mind. I-I should get going.
10310725.ch: 这真的很奇怪，譬如他们至死都要牵着对方，我只是想知道为什么。呃，不是，我、我该回去了。

10310727.en: Hey, I... I've been having strange dreams lately... The me in those dreams feels different from who I am now, yet somehow still myself... That version of me understands so much more than I do now...
10310727.ch: 喂，我……最近总是做一些奇怪的梦……梦里面的我，好像不是现在我的，但又好像就是我自己……那个我比现在的我懂事多了……

10310730.en: {name|B} gives a small smile, then looks at you sheepishly, as if trying to apologize.
10310730.ch: {name|B}笑笑，然后不好意思的看着你，似乎是在传达歉意。

10310731.en: People say when a man and woman share a deep connection, they become spouses, but when two women share such a bond, they become sworn sisters. I really wish I had an older sister like you—someone who could always be there to guide me.
10310731.ch: 人们都说男和女的情投意合，就结为夫妻，女的和女的情投意合就结为异姓姐妹。我真想有你这么个姐姐，一直陪着我，提点我。

10310732.en: Once I've built my house, if I get the chance, I want us to become sworn sisters!
10310732.ch: 等到我建好了房子，我想有机会的话，就和你结为姐妹！

10310733.en: {name|B} giggles and starts to lean against your shoulder when a roar suddenly echoes from nearby. You both turn around to see a Mythical Beast lunging towards you. It strikes {name|B}, sending her flying through the air before she crashes to the ground...
10310733.ch: {name|B}嘻嘻一笑，似乎想跟你肩并肩靠着，正在此时不远处传来啸声，你两一同回首，只见远处一只大妖兽猛扑而来，撞中{name|B}，使她远远抛飞开去跌落地上……

10310737.en: {name|B} crouches on the ground, {gender1|B} eyes clouded and distant as {gender|B} struggles to recall something...
10310737.ch: 只见{name|B}蹲坐地上，目光之中一片混沌，似乎正在竭力追忆着什么东西……

10310738.en: <r>Your enemies watch you like predators, and they'll... But the Guardian Handmaiden's mission is to protect her most precious ones at all costs, and I'll also protect my most cherished one at all costs...</r>
10310738.ch: <r>你身边的仇人对你虎视眈眈，他们……会护法侍女……本身是要不惜一切保护自己最重要的人……我……要不惜一切保护自己最重要的人……</r>

10310739.en: (High probability to trigger when player walks near residence)
10310739.ch: 玩家在住处附近行走大概率行走触发

10310740.en: Taking a leisurely stroll, are you? Well, the only path ahead of you leads straight to the underworld. Die!
10310740.ch: 你悠哉游哉的，是要去哪？不过我看你的前路只有幽冥黄泉了，去死吧！

10310741.en: A cultivator suddenly emerges and lunges at you, but in that same instant, {name|B} appears and deflects the assailant with a swift punch.
10310741.ch: 前方修士突然现身朝你攻来，便在同时，{name|B}瞬间现身挥出一拳将来人挡开。

10310742.en: You meddlesome girl, it's you again! You may have saved them once, but you won't manage it a second time!
10310742.ch: 小娘皮，又是你！你救得此人一次，救不了两次！

10310743.en: The figure shoots you a fierce glare, then turns a venomous gaze toward {name|B}. With gritted teeth, the person vanishes in a flash.
10310743.ch: 那人狠狠的瞪了你一眼，又怀有怨毒地扫视{name|B}，最后咬了咬牙，闪身去了。

10310744.en: Sigh. Making too many enemies is dangerous—it puts you at risk. But... but I will protect you; <r>even if it costs me my life, I will protect you!</r>
10310744.ch: 唉，多结仇怨总是不好的，会让你置身险境。不过、不过我会保护你的，<r>便是死，我也会保护你的！</r>

10310745.en: {name|B} gives you a gentle smile before heading back to her house.
10310745.ch: {name|B}朝你笑笑，便又朝她的房子去了。

10310746.en: {name|B} sits on the ground, engrossed in etching mysterious symbols—the earth around her covered in various patterns. Your approach catches her attention.
10310746.ch: 只见{name|B}蹲坐地上，正刻画着什么，地上满是各种图案。而你的接近引起了她的注意。

10310747.en: You gave me another chance at life and saved me... Thank you... <r>I swear, I will protect you with everything I have</r>.
10310747.ch: 你给了我再活一次的机会……救了我……感谢……<r>我会，不惜一切，努力保护你的</r>。

10310748.en: After speaking, she returns to her etching, completely absorbed in her work...
10310748.ch: 她说完便又埋首刻画什么……

10310749.en: You find {name|B} pinning a cultivator to the ground, her face twisted with uncertainty as she struggles with what to do next...
10310749.ch: 只见{name|B}将一名修士制于地上，她脸上显现苦恼之色，似乎正烦恼应该怎么处置此人……

10310750.en: Hey, hey, hey! What's with the arm lock? You're going to break my arm!
10310750.ch: 喂喂喂，拧着我干嘛？手要断了！

10310751.en: You were trying to ambush {name|A}! You're here for revenge!
10310751.ch: 你是要偷袭{name|A}，你是来寻仇的！

10310752.en: {name|B} hesitates to strike the fatal blow. Seizing this moment of mercy, the cultivator casts a spell to break free, transforming into a streak of light and darting away. As the cultivator flees, you hear a threat that no one can protect {name|A} forever.
10310752.ch: {name|B}并不狠下杀手，那修士看得她分身，忙施法脱身，化为一道流光，扎向远方。此人边去边叫嚣，说是谁都无法一直保护{name|A}。

10310753.en: For those precious to me, <r>I will protect them even at the cost of my life!</r>
10310753.ch: 只要是重要的人，<r>就算死，也要保护！</r>

10310754.en: With newfound resolve burning in her eyes, {name|B} walks away until she vanishes into the horizon.
10310754.ch: {name|B}下了什么决心似的，渐行渐远，转眼消失于地天之间。

10310755.en: {name|B} scans the area intently, a piece of ebony wood in her hand as she searches for special timber. Suddenly, a surge of killing intent erupts from behind you as a vicious beast lunges forth! Sensing your peril, she rushes to shield you, channeling energy through her palm to crush the beast beneath it...
10310755.ch: 只见{name|B}手拿一截黑乌木，正于前方四处张望，似乎正寻找什么特别木材。此时身后杀意激涨，一只凶手猛扑而出，女子同时察觉你的危机一把冲来挡在你身前，抬手间释出灵力，将恶兽摧于掌底……

10310756.en: You are... precious to me... <r>I will protect you... protect you even if it costs my life...</r>
10310756.ch: 你是……重要的人，<r>我会保护你的……死也要保护你……</r>

10310757.en: A bright light flashes in her eyes before fading back to darkness. With a quiet sigh, she returns to her search for ebony wood.
10310757.ch: 面前女子眼中澄光亮起，复又变得一片晦暗，她松了口气，又去寻找乌木。

10310760.en: At last, I've found you! There's something I've come to collect today—your life!
10310760.ch: 终于寻到你了，今天我想向你借一样东西，你的命！

10310761.en: The assailant waves their hand to cast a spell, gathering crackling energy into a beam of light that shoots forward. Suddenly, a purple flash cuts through the air as {name|B} appears! With a single sweep of her arm, she sends the cultivator crashing to the ground unconscious...
10310761.ch: 面前之人说着挥手施法，灵力滋滋的响瞬间聚成光柱朝面前射来。然而此时紫影一闪，{name|B}突然现身，她藕臂一挥，登时将面前修士击倒地上昏晕过去……

10310762.en: Oh no! This is bad. I completely messed up this person's face... I thought just a light tap wouldn't hurt.
10310762.ch: 哎呀！惨了，这人脸都被打歪了……我以为轻轻碰一下不会让他受伤的呢？

10310763.en: L-look here, I've been tracking this person for a while! They were plotting to kill you! Please, can you stop making so many enemies? It's dangerous! Don't think they'll only come after you at predictable times—these people are far more cunning than that!
10310763.ch: 话、话说，我跟踪很久了！这人想要谋害你呢！我、我能不能请你别结太多仇人了？那会很危险的！别以为这些家伙都只会月头月尾来光明正大的寻仇，他们可狡猾了！

10310764.en: Listen... these enemies are always plotting against you. Maybe... you should try to make peace with them instead?
10310764.ch: 你……身边仇总是设法对你不利，我看要不你尽量和他们和解吧？

10310765.en: With all their schemes and plots... they're bound to harm you someday.
10310765.ch: 不然他们百般算计，总有一日，会伤害到你的。

10310766.en: I'll do everything I can to protect you, but I'm afraid... afraid that I won't be able to keep you safe...
10310766.ch: 我会尽力保护你的，但是我害怕……害怕没办法保护你……

10310767.en: {name|B} lets out a soft sigh, her face a mixture of worry and pain. Then, she turns and walks away after sharing these words.
10310767.ch: {name|B}轻轻叹了口气，脸上既是担忧又是难受，跟你说过这番话后便转身离开了。

10310768.en: {name|A}, your enemies have made several moves against you lately, and I'm worried about your safety... Perhaps you could try to make peace with them?
10310768.ch: {name|A}，近日你的仇人几次冒犯，我担心你的安危……你要不要和他们设法讲和？

10310769.en: I... I'll protect you! But they're so full of schemes and tricks... I just can't keep up with them all.
10310769.ch: 我……我会保护你的！但是，他们诡计多端……我实在应付不来。

10310770.en: I'm sorry... I just want to protect you, but they're too cunning... I'm afraid they'll eventually get the better of you.
10310770.ch: 对不起……我只是希望保护你，但这些太狡猾了……我怕你终有一天会被他们算计。

10310771.en: {name|B} looks deeply worried as she rambles on with her concerns. Eventually, she seems to realize how much she's been talking and shyly takes her leave...
10310771.ch: {name|B}看起来十分担忧，她絮絮叨叨的给你说了很多，最后好像发现自己说得太多了，便羞答答的走了……

10310772.en: (Trigger this event when player's enemy count exceeds 3)
10310772.ch: 当玩家仇人超过3个时暂停事件进程触发该事件

10310773.ch: 在木偶住处附近生成事件，

10310774.en: In the distance, {name|B} stands face to face with a cultivator. The cultivator suddenly collapses, kneeling on the ground and coughing up blood.
10310774.ch: 只见{name|B}与一名修士遥遥相对，那名修士最终一把跪倒地上吐出一口鲜血。

10310775.en: Hmph! It's you... I've tried to ambush you several times, but this dimwit woman kept getting in my way. I thought I'd destroy her first, but even when I made my move, she still managed to turn the tables on me...
10310775.ch: 哼！是你……我几次便要暗算你，都被这痴呆女子挡下了，便打算先将这女的先打为齑粉，没想到我暗算出手，还是被她反败为胜……

10310776.en: You got... lucky this time... but neither you nor she will meet... a good end. Either she dies first... or you do... One day, I will settle this score between us...
10310776.ch: 算你……运气，不过你……和她都不会有好下场的，要么她先死……要么你先死……终有一日，我会了解我们之间的仇怨的……

10310777.en: Your enemy continues to cough blood between words, then finally struggles to their feet and limps away.
10310777.ch: 眼前你的仇人边说边咳血，最终后站了起来。一拐一拐的离开了。

10310778.en: Your grievously wounded enemy stands before you as you unleash your energy. The person's body suddenly becomes brittle as dead wood, crumbling to dust that scatters in the wind. Seeing her great foe destroyed, {name|B} finally collapses to her knees.
10310778.ch: 仇人身受重创，你灵力发出，他身体顿如朽木，一下便酥成齑粉，散落空中。{name|B}眼看大敌已去，终于一把跪倒在地。

10310779.en: I... I'm fine... Don't make enemies; they'll plot their revenge with such cunning... it's impossible to guard against them all...
10310779.ch: 我……我没事的……不要结仇，他们处心积虑报复，防不胜防……

10310780.en: {name|B} staggers back to her Origin Box. Once inside, she collapses onto the floor and begins circulating her energy to heal her internal wounds.
10310780.ch: {name|B}说着一部一顿的走回归元木匣之中，遥见她回入屋中便一把坐倒，自顾自运转灵力，恢复体内肌理。

10310781.en: Inside her chamber, {name|B} sits in meditation as spiritual light flickers around her, refining her Qi to heal her wounds. Though she maintains her meditative pose, she keeps mumbling to herself like someone talking in their sleep.
10310781.ch: 只见{name|B}于屋内打坐，身周灵光闪烁，似乎正在炼气存神，修复身体伤创。然则她虽坐功存神，但嘴里却喃喃细语，仿如梦呓。

10310782.en: Protect... the most precious one... protect... even at the cost of my life...
10310782.ch: 保护……最重要的人……死也要保护……

10310783.en: Seeing her great foe depart, {name|B} finally collapses to her knees.
10310783.ch: {name|B}眼看大敌离去，终于一把跪倒在地。

10310786.en: Hmph, I've waited long for this. That dimwit woman isn't here today—no one to interfere. Perfect timing to settle our old score! Prepare to die!
10310786.ch: 哼，我等你好久了。今日那个痴呆女不在，无人妨碍，正是你我清算昔日旧怨的时候！受死吧！

10310787.en: Ugh! Like a persistent ghost, you still followed... Hmph, that woman may have ruined my supreme luck, but mark my words—one day you'll both fall into my hands!
10310787.ch: 呃！阴魂不散的家伙，还是跟来了……哼，这痴呆女虽破我无上气运，但总教有一天你们会落在我手上。

10310788.en: She takes the blow meant for you and lies on the ground, barely clinging to life. As she looks up at you, her trembling hand reaches out to feel your cheek.
10310788.ch: 她替你挡下一击，躺在地上，已然奄奄一息，她看了看你，颤抖着伸出手来摸了摸你的脸颊。

10310789.en: Human skin is so warm... so soft and pleasant... I'm so tired... so sleepy...
10310789.ch: 人类的皮肉暖暖的，软软的好舒服，好累，好困……

10310790.en: I'm about to fall asleep... Remember this... Don't make enemies in the future... A true cultivator knows when to conceal their light and endure hardship... Don't put yourself in danger...
10310790.ch: 我快要睡着了，你记着……以后不要结怨，韬光养晦，忍辱含垢，才是真正修道人的本色……不要把自己置于危险之中……

10310791.en: As she speaks these words, the hand caressing your cheek suddenly falls limp. The light in her eyes flickers one last time before fading into darkness, leaving her completely still. Like wisps of smoke carried away by the wind, the gentle soul departs...
10310791.ch: 正说着，她摸着你脸颊的手突然耷拉垂下，同时眼中神光一闪迅速黯淡，便再无动静。伊人芳魂，一缕烟消，她离开了……

10310792.en: {name|B}, already wounded multiple times and exhausted from helping you battle the enemy, has finally reached her limit. At last, she collapses to her knees...
10310792.ch: {name|B}似乎身上接连受创，又协助你与仇人恶战，物力有时而穷，此时终于一把跪倒地上……

10310796.en: You arrive at {name|B}'s dwelling, but no one is there. It seems she hasn't returned from her outing.
10310796.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，然而里面空无一人，看来她外出未归。

10310797.en: What kind of creature are you? Human or demon? Your constitution... is truly unique.
10310797.ch: 你到底是什么怪物？是人还是妖呢？你这体质……真是天下少有。

10310798.en: Why don't you come with me? I'd love to... study you thoroughly. What do you say?
10310798.ch: 不如你随我走一趟，让我好好的研究研究，如何？

10310800.en: Who dares interfere? I'll deal with you first, then take my time with this frost-ridden freak!
10310800.ch: 哪来的人，先对付了你再慢慢整治这浑身寒气的怪胎！

10310802.en: As the cultivator lunges at you, {name|B} makes a single gesture. The attacker instantly collapses, frost spreading across their flesh and clothes until, in the blink of an eye, they become nothing more than an ice sculpture...
10310802.ch: 这修士往你攻来，未料{name|B}只一挥手，那修士立即倒在地上，皮肉衣衫凝冰结霜，眨眼被冻成一个冰雕……

10310804.en: After freezing the attacker, {name|B} appears troubled by her actions. With a sigh, she turns and walks away.
10310804.ch: {name|B}一举将人冻住后似乎生出不快，她叹了口气，便转头走了。

10310805.en: Another nuisance? Fine, I'll get rid of this meddler first, then give you proper attention, you frozen freak!
10310805.ch: 碍事的人来了，我先把此人赶走了，再好好的关照你这冷冰冰的怪胎！

10310807.en: You'll remember this, mark my words!

10310809.en: I'm sorry... for dragging you into this...

10310810.en: {name|B} appears deeply saddened. With a heavy sigh, she turns and walks away...
10310810.ch: {name|B}似乎十分难过，她叹了口气，便转头走了……

10310811.en: Agh! The pain... I won't take it! Get away! Leave me alone! You can't possibly change my destiny!
10310811.ch: 啊！我好痛苦……我不吃！你走开！走开！你根本没办法化解我的气运！

10310812.en: Just take this one! The previous medicine poisoned you, but this one will surely cure it... Won't you give it a try? Please, trust me.
10310812.ch: 吃了这颗就可以了！前面的药让你中毒了，后面这颗一定能解毒……试一下吧？请你相信我吧？

10310813.en: One pill already tore my insides apart; another will dissolve me completely! No, a thousand times no!
10310813.ch: 吃了一颗就肠穿肚烂，再吃不把我整个人都化了！不吃，一千个不吃，一万个不吃！

10310814.en: {name|B} takes out a pill and holds the cultivator's chin firmly. Weakened by pill poison, the cultivator cannot resist as {name|B} swiftly pushes the medicine into their mouth, making them swallow it.
10310814.ch: {name|B}手拈一颗丹丸，然后用手抵住修士下巴。此人中了丹毒，无力抗拒，{name|B}只一下便将药丸送进其嘴里，让其服下。

10310815.en: Ah! I'm dying! Wait... the pain is gone?
10310815.ch: 啊！我要死了！咦，好像不难受了？

10310816.en: See... I told you it would work.
10310816.ch: 你看吧……我就说能解开的。

10310817.en: Thank you, fellow cultivator. If not for your help, I wouldn't have survived this ordeal. And... thanks to that cold-mannered lady as well. But I dare not take any more medicine—you keep the rest. I must take my leave!
10310817.ch: 多谢道友，幸好道友帮助这才度过一劫。也多谢这位冷冰冰的女道友。不过，剩下的我是不敢服了，道友你拿着，我先走了！

10310818.en: The cultivator looks back at {name|B} one last time, trembling like a leaf before hastily fleeing the scene. {name|B} feels a deep sense of dejection and, with a resigned sigh, takes her leave.
10310818.ch: 那修士又回头看了看{name|B}，身子筛糠似的颤了颤，连忙转身逃了。{name|B}颇感失落，无奈下只叹了口气便离开了。

10310820.en: Ah! My baneful destiny is lifted... but why does my stomach feel so terrible!
10310820.ch: 啊！我之前的气运化解了……但是为什么我感觉肚子特别难受！

10310822.en: Murder! This quack is trying to kill me!

10310823.en: The cultivator is terrified of {name|B}, scrambling away in panic when she tries to check. {name|B} appears deeply hurt, forcing a smile when her eyes meet yours before wandering off in a daze.
10310823.ch: 那修士怕极了{name|B}，眼看她药上前查看，连滚带爬的逃了。{name|B}似乎颇为失落，与你对视一眼后笑笑，便茫然去了。

10310824.en: Greetings, fellow cultivator. I'm grateful you convinced that cold-mannered lady to give me the elixir. Though I spent ten days dealing with, eh, severe stomach issues, at least I'm alive to tell the tale.
10310824.ch: 道友好，当日所幸你让那位冷冰冰的女道友让我服下丹药，虽然后面我大泻十日，但好歹性命是保住了。

10310825.en: Please accept this small token of gratitude, fellow cultivator. Farewell.
10310825.ch: 这是一点心意，盼望道友收下，再见。

10310827.en: Alright... I won't force you to take the medicine. Please don't be afraid...
10310827.ch: 好……我不逼你服药，你别怕……

10310828.en: The cultivator scrambles away in absolute terror, practically crawling on all fours. With a heavy sigh, {name|B} pushes the remaining elixirs into your hands before walking away...
10310828.ch: 那修士吓得屁滚尿流，手脚并用，爬着离开了。{name|B}叹了口气将剩下的丹药塞到你手上，便离开了……

10310830.en: Seeing you lost in thought after arriving at her home, {name|B} quietly busies herself with something without disturbing you. A moment later, she places an item in your hands.
10310830.ch: {name|B}看你来到家中以后一直出神，她也不打扰你，便自行张罗着什么，片刻后将一个物事放到你手中。

10310832.en: Um, I rarely venture out unless necessary, but... if you have time, can you visit me in the Everfrost? I'll... I'll be waiting there for you.
10310832.ch: 唔，如非必要，我都不会在外逗留，你若有闲暇，就来冰原看我吧？我……会一直在那等你的。

10310833.en: Hey, I... I made some elixirs. Would you mind testing them for me?
10310833.ch: 喂，我……做了一些丹药，可否请你帮忙试试？

10310834.en: As she speaks, she fishes out several pills from a large vat filled with bubbling green liquid and places them in your hand...
10310834.ch: 说着，她从一个盛着绿色液体不断冒着气泡的大缸里捞出几颗药丸递到你手中……

10310835.en: It should be... fine. Why don't you give it a try?
10310835.ch: 应该……不会有问题的，试试吧？

10310836.en: After taking the elixir, you feel an agitated heat surge through your body and rush to your head. An unsettling sensation begins to spread throughout your entire being...
10310836.ch: 你服下丹药，但觉一股亢燥的热流从体内生出，直透脑门，一股不好的感觉弥漫全身……

10310837.en: Your face has completely changed color... Here, take these to help restore your health... I-I'm so sorry!
10310837.ch: 你……你的脸色都变了……这些你拿着，服下补补身体……对、对不起！

10310838.en: After taking the elixir, a gentle warmth rises and flows through your body. A soothing sensation of harmony spreads to every corner of your being, leaving you in a state of profound comfort.
10310838.ch: 你服下丹药后，但觉一股暖意升起，遍流全身，你一时之间只觉遍体阳和，舒适不已。

10310839.en: Looks like... it worked. Keep these elixirs with you just in case—you never know when you might need them.
10310839.ch: 好像……有效，这些丹药你备而不用，先拿着吧，指不定后面还会有什么意外。

10310840.en: So you're scared after all... Never mind.

10310841.en: I've been trying to create medicine to purge the cold energy from my body, but nothing seems to work yet. Still, I won't give up—and you'll have to help me test more of them!
10310841.ch: 我想试着炼药祛除体内的寒气，但似乎成效不著。但我会继续尝试的，你，要多帮我试药！

10310842.en: I've made some new elixirs recently. Since you're always adventuring and facing dangers, take these with you as a precaution. It'll put my mind at ease.
10310842.ch: 近日我炼制了一些丹药，你在外闯荡，常遇风险，拿着一些备而不用，也好安心。

10310843.en: Why are you skulking around like that? Don't tell me you're waiting for the end of the month to start trouble again!
10310843.ch: 鬼鬼祟祟的跟着人家干嘛？又等着过月去找人晦气吗！

10310844.en: You've got it all wrong, miss!

10310845.en: Wronged? Too bad—you shouldn't have let me catch you! There's a lovely Mystic Realm I know of, and its exit only opens once every sixty years. Why don't you go in and enjoy the view?
10310845.ch: 冤枉？就算冤枉也只能怪你被我撞见了！那处秘境风光明媚，出口一个甲子洞开一回，你进去好好享受吧！

10310846.en: You're actually willing to let me go... Was I really being too petty all this time...
10310846.ch: 你竟然愿意放了我……过往是我太小气了吗……

10310847.en: Of course you were being petty! Harassing someone over such a trivial matter—how annoying can you get!
10310847.ch: 肯定是你小气了啊。为了这点小事就去缠着人家，很烦人的！

10310848.en: Yes... I've finally come to my senses. I'm sorry...
10310848.ch: 是，我如今已幡然醒悟了，抱歉……

10310849.en: The cultivator walks away in low spirits with these words.
10310849.ch: 这名修士说着失魂落魄的走了。

10310850.en: Here, take these! Hehe! I managed to catch that guy, and he handed over all his valuables before I could even threaten him. I'm off!
10310850.ch: 给你玩！嘿嘿！我想办法抓了这家伙，还没开始威胁他就将身上值钱的都拿出来了。我走啦！

10310851.en: (You got some precious Immortal Wardrobe material.)

10310852.en: Let them go? These types might look pitiful, but they'll stab you in the back the first chance they get. Despicable!
10310852.ch: 放了？这些家伙看着可怜，指不定就要朝你反咬一口，可恶极了！

10310853.en: My lady, you are right... especially about what you just said! Now die!
10310853.ch: 仙子教训都是对的……特别是刚刚说的！受死吧！

10310854.en: Haha! See? What did I tell you! I knew this guy would stab you in the back!
10310854.ch: 哈哈！你看，我就说嘛！这家伙肯定要反咬你一口！

10310855.en: Ah, let's beat this guy to a pulp first and talk later!
10310855.ch: 哎，我们先揍扁这家伙再说！

10310856.en: He's running! Look at that! Not much of a fighter, but luckily he can run—what a swift escape artist!
10310856.ch: 跑了跑了！实力不怎么样，脚力倒是很厉害嘛，逃起命来真麻利！

10310857.en: Don't be upset! When that guy was begging me to let him go, he handed over all his good stuff! Here, take these!
10310857.ch: 不要不开心！这家伙求我放他的时候，把身上的好东西都送我了！给你玩！

10310858.en: (You got some common Immortal Wardrobe material.)

10310859.en: Ah! I absolutely refuse to stay in there for sixty years!
10310859.ch: 啊！我绝不会在里面呆六十年的！

10310860.en: Hey, look at you run! Fine, go ahead! But next time I catch you, I'm throwing you into a Mystic Realm that only opens once every hundred and twenty years!
10310860.ch: 嘿，跑得可真快！好啊，你走！下次逮着你了，把你送到出口两个甲子洞开一次的秘境里！

10310861.en: Hmph, hiding back there while I dealt with your enemy, were you? Here, take these—the guy got so scared after a few threats that he handed over everything he had.
10310861.ch: 哼，躲在后面看我给你整治仇人啊？给你拿去玩，这家伙唬了几句，吓得不轻，把身上东西都交出来了。

10310862.en: I'm off to have fun elsewhere! Don't forget to come find me later!
10310862.ch: 我去别的地方玩耍啦，记得来找我玩呀！

10310864.en: Who wants your life? I'm just going to lock you up so you can reflect on your actions. Coming around every month looking for revenge—it's such a nuisance, don't you think?!
10310864.ch: 谁要你的命，我只把你关在里面，让你静思己过，不要动不动就过月找人报仇，这样可烦了好不！

10310865.en: Just endure it! Sixty years will pass in the blink of an eye. When you get out, your children will be all grown up—won't that be nice? Uh... wait, after sixty years... those children might not even be yours...
10310865.ch: 忍一忍，瞬间六十年瞬间就过去了，到时你出来了，孩子都长大了这样多好？呃，六十年，这孩子都不知道是不是你的……

10310866.en: Never mind that—just remember when you get out, stop harassing people! Got it? Bye, good cultivator!
10310866.ch: 这个不重要了，你到时候要记住，不要再缠住人家！知道了吗！乖，进去吧。

10310867.en: The cultivator, now subdued, is dragged and tossed into the spatial rift by Ao Yao. After the rift seals itself shut, she dusts off her hands with a satisfied smile and walks away.
10310867.ch: 那修士似被制住，被敖瑶拖着一把丢进空间裂隙里面。片刻后空间裂隙弥合，她才笑吟吟的拍了拍手离开了。

10310869.en: Of course not! I've been inside myself—there are treasures everywhere in there!
10310869.ch: 肯定没有啊，我都进去过了，里面宝物可多了。

10310871.en: What's there to think about? Get in, quick! It's now or never—once the rift closes, who knows when it'll open again!
10310871.ch: 还考虑什么？快进去吧！过了这村就没这店了，裂隙一旦关闭，都不知何年何月才重新打开！

10310872.en: After a moment's hesitation, the female cultivator steps inside. Ao Yao lets out a soft chuckle as she seals the rift with her spell, trapping her victim within.
10310872.ch: 那女修想了想终于一步踏入，敖瑶轻轻一笑施法弥合裂隙，将人关在里面。

10310874.en: Ao Yao meets your gaze unflinchingly, refusing to back down, though a flash of sadness crosses her eyes. With a defiant huff, she finally waves her hand and reopens the spatial rift.
10310874.ch: 敖瑶和你直面对视，分毫不让，但眼睛之中却掠过一丝难过。她似乎不服气似的，哼了一声，终于一挥手，重新打开裂隙。

10310876.en: Visibly upset, Ao Yao tosses several treasures at you before opening the rift. With a petulant stomp of her foot, she storms off.
10310876.ch: 敖瑶似乎有些不快，她抬手一扔，将几件宝物丢到你身上，便打开裂隙，一跺脚走了。

10310877.en: Why so worried? I was just messing with her for fun.
10310877.ch: 着急了吗？跟这家伙闹着玩罢了。

10310878.en: Ao Yao gives you a long, meaningful look before waving her hand to reopen the spatial rift. She seems upset, several times starting to speak before thinking better of it and holding her tongue.
10310878.ch: 敖瑶幽幽的看了你一眼，然后挥手重新打开洞天裂隙。她看起来有点生气，有几次欲言又止，终于又忍住了。

10310880.en: Clearly displeased, Ao Yao tosses several treasures at you before letting out a deep sigh and walking away.
10310880.ch: 敖瑶颇为不快，她抬手一扔，将几件宝物丢到你身上，幽幽一叹后便走了。

10310881.en: Look at this! There's plenty more over there!
10310881.ch: 你看这个！那边还有很多！

10310882.en: Ah! These are precious materials from the Immortal Wardrobe! There's more over there?
10310882.ch: 啊！是仙衣阁的珍贵材料！那边还有？

10310883.en: The female cultivator eagerly mounts her sword and flies off in the direction Ao Yao pointed, disappearing in the blink of an eye...
10310883.ch: 这名女修兴冲冲的依敖瑶指点方向御剑而去，转瞬不见……

10310884.en: Hehe, sorry for ruining your little moment! Here's something to make up for it!
10310884.ch: 嘻嘻，坏了你的好事，真抱歉啊！这是赔偿，喏。

10310885.en: Ao Yao tosses some treasures your way and departs with a mischievous giggle...
10310885.ch: 敖瑶将一些宝物抛给你，然后笑嘻嘻的离开了……

10310886.en: Stop staring! Why do you keep ogling those female cultivators?
10310886.ch: 不准看！怎么一直盯着人家女修看！

10310887.en: She appears displeased, turning away with a pout on her face.
10310887.ch: 她似乎有些不快，撇了撇嘴转身离开了。

10310888.en: Look at me! Am I not pretty enough? Why do you keep looking at those girls?
10310888.ch: 看我，我不好看吗？干嘛看这些姑娘！

10310890.en: Ao Yao's anger deflates suddenly into dejection as she lets out a sigh, slowly backing away from you...
10310890.ch: 敖瑶原本气鼓鼓的，但突然间又意兴阑珊的叹了叹，慢慢朝你退开几步……

10310892.en: How would you feel if I started ogling other male cultivators?
10310892.ch: 如果我也去盯着别的男修士，你会乐意吗？

10310893.en: Ao Yao lets out a soft sigh and walks away.
10310893.ch: 敖瑶说完，微微一叹，转身去了。

10310895.en: Hmm, something seems off about this realm. What should we do?
10310895.ch: 唔，这洞天好像有些古怪，怎么办呢？

10310896.en: As you enter the Mystic Realm, a monster lunges out with its jaws wide open, ferociously charging toward you.
10310896.ch: 你进入洞天秘境后，里面扑出妖兽，张开大嘴，气势汹汹的朝你扑来。

10310897.en: I knew something was wrong! This is all your fault! And you made me come in here with you!
10310897.ch: 我就知道有古怪！都怪你！还让我陪你进去！

10310898.en: Ugh! It's your fault, your fault, YOUR FAULT! Now we have to fight again!
10310898.ch: 唉！怪你怪你怪你！又要动手了！

10310899.en: Oh! These are some nice drops! Come on, let's split them!
10310899.ch: 咦，东西不错啊！来，我们分了！

10310900.en: She divides the monster's treasures with you, grinning happily before contentedly heading off elsewhere.
10310900.ch: 她笑嘻嘻的和你分了妖兽落下的宝物，心满意足的又往别处去了。

10310901.en: Haha! Vile creature, this dragon princess will be your doom!
10310901.ch: 哈哈！妖孽，看本公主讨伐你！

10310902.en: This monster's got some nice loot on it. Here, take some!
10310902.ch: 这妖兽身上有不少好东西呢。给！

10310903.en: Hey, I really enjoy having you around.
10310903.ch: 喂，有你陪着，我很开心呢。

10310905.en: Upon entering the realm, you're greeted by a hauntingly beautiful vista—misty mountains in the distance and winding rivers like silk ribbons across the landscape. Ao Yao stands transfixed by the scenery. The ethereal mist surrounding her transforms her into an otherworldly beauty, as delicate as a celestial maiden.
10310905.ch: 进入洞天后，只见远山含烟，河溪如带，极尽凄美之事。敖瑶被美景吸引，忍不住驻足观看。周围烟光映衬之下，眼前女子仿佛蒙上一层氤氲，仿佛缥缈仙子，娇美不胜。

10310906.en: So beautiful... won't you... stay with me...

10310907.en: A gentle light glows in Ao Yao's eyes, replacing her usual playfulness. Like a tranquil spring pool, her gaze ripples with crystalline clarity, brimming with unspoken longing.
10310907.ch: 敖瑶眼中神光温柔，一改往日娇俏，仿佛面前的春水，涟涟的，莹莹的，透着说不尽的期待。

10310908.en: A faint blush colors Ao Yao's cheeks as she nods. She assumes the lotus position and joins hands with you. Your energies intertwine, coursing through each other's bodies, exploring every hidden corner within. As the energies flow back and forth, you both enter a state of pure tranquility. A surge of energy rises from your core and floods your mind, leaving your entire body in a state of languid bliss, forgetting everything in this moment.
10310908.ch: 敖瑶脸上微红，点了点头。她作莲座之态，与你舒掌相握。你们彼此间的灵力在对方体内游梭，仿佛要探遍脏腑间的每一处隐秘。此来彼去间，你们同时进入一片无知之境，一股灵力由丹田窜起直灌脑门，那以后四肢百骸只充满懒洋洋的舒适感，浑不知今夕何夕。

10310909.en: Hey, I wish we could stay here forever... But if the realm closes, we'll have to waste energy finding another exit. Should we head out first?
10310909.ch: 喂，我真想跟你在这一直呆着呢。不过，洞天缺口一旦关闭又得耗费心神另寻出口，我们还是先离开吧？

10310910.en: Ao Yao, usually so cheerful and straightforward, now speaks with unusual gentleness, her cheeks flushed pink. After speaking, she turns away shyly and walks ahead...
10310910.ch: 一向欢快爽直的敖瑶，脸上嫣红一片，说话也极尽温柔，她说过了话，害羞似的转身当先离去了……

10310911.en: Once you're beside her, Ao Yao gently leans against you, resting her shoulder against yours as you both stand there.
10310911.ch: 敖瑶等你站到旁边，便轻轻往你身上一倒，站着用肩膀靠着你。

10310912.en: I wish we could stay like this forever, just standing here together...
10310912.ch: 真想跟你在这一直站着，就这么一直站着……

10310913.en: As she speaks, Ao Yao's gaze grows distant and dreamy, but she quickly snaps out of it, giving you a gentle smile.
10310913.ch: 敖瑶说着眼神变得十分迷离，但只片刻她便又恢复过来，与你笑笑。

10310914.en: Just kidding. Even if you could stand here forever, I definitely couldn't! Come on, let's go—we'll be in trouble if the realm closes.
10310914.ch: 说笑的。就算你受得了，我也受不了。我们走吧，别要洞天缺口关闭了，就麻烦了。

10310915.en: With contentment written all over her face, Ao Yao walks ahead toward the exit...
10310915.ch: 敖瑶心满意足的走在前方，往出口而去了……

10310916.en: Let's get going—we don't want to run into those pathetic cultivators playing victim again. Oh right, here's something for you. I collected these especially with you in mind!
10310916.ch: 那我们走吧，别要进去又遇见那些装可怜的修士。对了，这个给你，这些可是我专门给你找的！

10310917.en: Ao Yao places the treasures in your hands and walks away with a playful smile.
10310917.ch: 敖瑶将宝物交到你手上，笑嘻嘻的就走了。

10310918.en: Hey there! It's been forever since you last visited! Come over to my place when you get the chance! Look what I found—lots of good stuff!
10310918.ch: 喂，你很久没来找我了啊！快找个时间到我家来玩！看，我找到不少好东西呢！

10310919.en: Hey! Have you forgotten about me? Why don't you ever come visit? Look—I've found lots of treasures lately!
10310919.ch: 喂，是不是忘了我呀？怎么也不来找我玩？看，最近我找到不少宝物呢！

10310920.en: Oh right, I found these while exploring a Mystic Realm recently. I remember these are quite valuable to you cultivators, so I'm giving them all to you!
10310920.ch: 对了，这些都是前不久查探秘境时找到的，我记得这些对于你们八荒修士是顶不错的宝物，就都拿来送你啦。

10310921.en: The hatred between us can never be resolved. Today, we shall settle this with a duel to the death!
10310921.ch: 你我之间的仇恨无法可解，今日你我便单打独斗，决个生死吧！

10310922.en: Oh sure, a duel sounds great! Except it'll be you alone against the two of us.
10310922.ch: 好啊，单打独斗好啊！不过是你单打独斗我们两个。

10310925.en: I was wrong! Please be merciful and make that lady spare me!
10310925.ch: 我错了，求你大人有大量，让那位仙子饶了我！

10310927.en: Now, behave yourself from now on. Understood?
10310927.ch: 那你以后要乖乖的，知道了吗？

10310928.en: Hahahahaha, hahaha, haha, what do you really... want from me... HAHA—!
10310928.ch: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈，你到底，想要怎样……哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

10310929.en: I was just hoping to make the Sect Leader laugh and take a break, that's all!
10310929.ch: 这不是是盼着宗主给宗主放个假，开怀大笑一番吗？

10310930.en: Hahahahaha, I understand now, HAHAHAHAHA, you want to keep me here, HAHAHAHAHA, how could you do this!
10310930.ch: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈，我懂了，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈，你要留住我，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈，你怎能这样！

10310931.en: Hmm, you're {name|B}'s adversary, and you're not going anywhere until your sect falls into ruin. And judging from your current state...
10310931.ch: 嗯，你是{name|玩家}的对手，等到你宗门衰败之前，哪都别想去了。不过以你现在状况，

10310933.en: Hahahaha, such a righteous Sect Leader, hahaha, so honorable! I'm truly impressed, haha, such kindness you show! My... my humble sect, hah, wouldn't dare to challenge you again, HAHAHAHA... *hic*!
10310933.ch: 哈哈哈哈哈哈，宗主果然光明，哈哈哈哈，磊落，在下佩服，哈哈哈哈哈哈，承你恩情，敝宗哈哈哈哈哈，不敢，再与你争锋，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈……嗝！

10310934.en: In that case, Sect Leader, don't let me keep you.
10310934.ch: 既然如此，宗主好走不送。

10310935.en: Hahaha? Please remove, haha, my seal! HAHA—
10310935.ch: 哈哈哈哈？你不解了，哈哈哈哈哈，我的禁制？哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

10310936.en: Hey, you are always so busy with affairs of the sect, with never a smile to be seen. Isn't this state much better? The seal, in my opinion, is absolutely necessary.
10310936.ch: 宗主日理万机，难展欢颜，如今这样，不好吗？这禁制却是万万不能解的。

10310937.ch: 哈哈哈哈哈，哼！哈哈哈哈……嗝！

10310938.en: {name|B} gives a slight smile and walks away, never sparing another glance at the person.
10310938.ch: {name|B}微微一笑，转身离去，再没看那人一眼。

10310939.en: Dear cultivator, you, hahahaha, so righteous and noble, I... hahahaha, admire you, hahaha, and accept your kindness, HAHAHAHA—
10310939.ch: 阁下，哈哈哈哈哈，光明磊落，本座、哈哈哈哈哈，佩服，哈哈哈哈，你的情，我领了，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

10310940.en: But, hahaha, if our Sects ever come into conflict, I'll still fight with all my might, HAHAHA—
10310940.ch: 但，哈哈哈哈，日后宗门之间，哈哈哈哈，若起冲突，仍会全力一战，哈哈哈哈哈。

10310941.en: I shall, hahaha, await your next move, HAHAHAHA.
10310941.ch: 在下，哈哈哈哈，等着你的手段，哈哈哈哈哈哈。

10310942.en: A dangerous glint flashes in the enemy Sect Leader's eyes, as if his fighting spirit has been ignited. But this brief display of authority instantly crumbles as he breaks into another fit of hysterical laughter...
10310942.ch: 面前敌宗主眼中闪过厉芒，仿佛看见他浑身热血都被点燃了。但他的威仪只闪现一下便又抽搐似的嘻嘻哈哈的狂笑起来……

10310943.en: Tee-hee! When the time comes, let's have our battle while laughing like this, shall we?
10310943.ch: 噗呲，到时我们就这么嘻嘻哈哈哈的打一场吧。

10310945.en: Hahahaha, you plan to keep, hahaha, me here forever?
10310945.ch: 哈哈哈哈哈，你要一直留，哈哈哈哈，着我？

10310946.en: Indeed. You should take this time to rest and recover properly. Best to abandon those thoughts of sectarian supremacy—especially any notions of challenging {name|A}.
10310946.ch: 是啊，宗主便乘着这段日子好好休养生息，莫再存宗门争霸的念想了。特别是别想着和{name|A}争。

10310947.en: Hahahaha, I, hahahaha, hate you! HAHAHAHA, *hic*!
10310947.ch: 哈哈哈哈哈，我，哈哈哈哈哈，恨你，哈哈哈哈哈，嗝！

10310948.en: Very well, I shall take my leave now. Take care, Sect Leader.
10310948.ch: 好的，我这便告退了。宗主珍重。

10310950.en: Hahahaha, you won't keep me trapped here, HAHAHAHAHA.
10310950.ch: 哈哈哈哈哈，你别想困住我，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

10310951.en: This humble one has no special merits to speak of—I simply wish for you to stop opposing {name|A}. Please, take your time here to... reflect on this.
10310951.ch: 小女子何德何能，不过是想宗主莫要和{name|A}作对了。请宗主好好在这想想吧。

10310952.en: Hahaha, to hell with, HAHAHAHA, you! You dare treat me like this, hahaha! Once I get out of ha-here, hahaha, I'll ha-ha-have my revenge!
10310952.ch: 哈哈哈哈，想你个，哈哈哈哈哈哈，头！你这样整我，哈哈哈哈，一旦离开，哈哈哈哈，就找你报仇！

10310953.en: Indeed. This humble one shall await your... grand arrival.

10310955.en: A cultivator lies bound by energy shackles on the ground as a monster approaches them.
10310955.ch: 只见一名修士被灵力束缚地上，一只妖兽朝那人

10310956.en: No matter how grandly you speak of {name|A}, I don't care! I will never join {name|A}'s Sect!
10310956.ch: 任你说得{name|A}天花乱坠，那又如何！我不会加盟{name|A}的宗门的！

10310957.en: Fine by me. Stay here as long as you like—let's see how long before the scorching flames find you.
10310957.ch: 无妨，那你就这么呆着吧，看看何时会被那阳炎烧着？

10310958.en: Hey, wait! Where are you going?

10310959.en: I offered you kind words of advice, yet you refused to listen. What reason do I have to stay?
10310959.ch: 我良言相劝，你却不听。不走，还待怎地？

10310960.en: Alright, alright! Let me go! I'll do what you say.
10310960.ch: 好好好！你放了我！我听你的。

10310961.en: Very good. You may go now. Remember to speak properly to the Sect Leader—do I make myself clear?
10310961.ch: 甚好，这就走吧。记得好好和宗主说话，听清楚了吗？

10310963.en: The cultivator grinds his teeth in anger but finds himself completely powerless to resist. With no other choice, he lets out a bitter grunt and storms away, seething with resentment.
10310963.ch: 那修士恨得咬牙切齿，但偏又无可奈何，无奈下，只有哼了一声，恨恨而去。

10310964.en: It was just a little joke—nothing to take too seriously.
10310964.ch: 跟别人开个玩笑而已，别放在心上。

10310965.en: That person looked cold, so I had the monster warm them up. Now that they're nice and toasty, I've sent the monster away.
10310965.ch: 那人怕冷，我让妖兽给取个暖，这会那人身子暖和，我便让妖兽走了。

10310966.en: That person was making some unwise choices, getting mixed up with a monster. I merely offered some friendly persuasion.
10310966.ch: 那人想不开，跟妖兽搞在一起，我去劝说劝说罢了。

10310967.en: {name|B} flashes you a graceful smile, then turns and glides away...
10310967.ch: {name|B}说罢朝你嫣然一笑，便转身翩然而去……

10310968.en: Greetings, honorable Sect Leader! I wish to pledge my service to you—to devote my very life to your cause until my dying breath!
10310968.ch: 拜见宗主，我希望从此为你效力，鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已！

10310970.en: Most illustrious Sect Leader, your divine wisdom knows no bounds, your brilliant strategies are flawless, and your radiance illuminates all under heaven! I pledge my undying loyalty—no sacrifice is too great! Should you command me forward, I shall never take a step back. Your will is my absolute command!
10310970.ch: 宗主天纵英明，算无遗策，烛照天下，属下从此死心塌地，万死不辞！宗主让向前，我绝不敢向后，谨遵您的旨意，莫敢违抗！

10310971.en: Yes! Yes! Your insight into human nature is unmatched—you can instantly tell the worth of those who seek to join! With your supreme talent for choosing capable followers, the Sect shall surely flourish and unite all the world under your rule!
10310971.ch: 是！是！宗主洞悉人心，一眼就知道来投的人是好是坏，宗主任贤选能，以后定能光大宗门，一统八荒。

10310972.en: Wait, you... you don't want me? Well... fine! Your wisdom and might inspire absolute devotion and boundless admiration! Your greatness is like that of the highest mountain! Uh... I'll just take my leave now...
10310972.ch: 慢着，你……你不要我？这……好吧，宗主英明神武，教人死心塌地，景仰无比！高山仰止，景行行止！呃，那我先走了……

10310973.en: You see {name|B} engaged in a debate with another cultivator. The latter is sweating profusely, clearly flustered. In contrast, {name|B} remains composed and elegant as drifting clouds, apparently having the upper hand.
10310973.ch: 只见{name|B}与一名修士进行论道，那修士满头大汗，似乎颇为失措。反观{name|B}镇定闲雅，云淡风轻，似乎极有余裕。

10310974.en: As their discussion continues at length, you listen quietly from the side, gaining much insight. When the cultivator's lips begin to tremble and hands start to shake, it's clear who the victor will be.
10310974.ch: 二人讲论多时，而你则从旁静听，颇受教益。而后那修士口颤手抖，看来胜负已见分晓。

10310975.en: Your wisdom is profound, I must admit...
10310975.ch: 阁下见识高明，在下佩服……

10310977.en: She rises and turns, her robes stirring fallen leaves and dust—before they can even settle back to earth, she has already vanished into the distance.
10310977.ch: 她站起转身，衣角带起落叶轻尘，只见叶未落定，而人已去得远了。

10310978.en: As their discussion continues, you listen from the side, gaining insight yourself. The cultivator wracks his brain desperately, arguing with all his might, his face growing increasingly red—until suddenly, with a terrible cry, he collapses to the ground...
10310978.ch: 二人讲论多事，而你从旁静听，也受教益。只见修士绞尽脑汁，出言辩驳，那脸上渐渐涨红，突然间啊的一声惨叫倒地不起……
